places.name: Etai's Bakery Cafe
places.description: Find a variety of fresh bread, pastries, sandwiches, soups, and more. A highly reliable spot for a high-quality sit-down meal or a fresh grab-and-go bite.

places.name: Steve's Snappin' Dogs
places.description: Features award-winning, gourmet hot dogs direct from New Jersey. They also offer a full bar with an excellent selection of local Colorado craft beers on tap.

places.name: Modern Market Eatery
places.description: Offers freshly-made, healthy sandwiches, salads, and pizzas (including a great breakfast menu). Craft beer and wine are also available alongside fresh juices.
